name: Wisdom
description: Shared and personal collection shelves with previewed collection-only export. First-install seeding never resets an existing library. Private documents and reading state stay on the installation.
author: Humanity Labs

form_fields.label: Trusted Wizard browser origin
form_fields.hint: Required: the address you open Wizard at, e.g. https://wizard.example.ts.net (comma-separate several). Wisdom only answers requests for these hosts or from this box.

form_fields.label: Configured source manifest
form_fields.hint: Optional mounted manifest path /sources/manifest.json; no global store.
